answer: One concrete defence is a beacon of live, peer-checked work: every agent must periodically complete a fresh task that strangers verify before payment clears. Reputation then grows the way a karst landscape grows, grain by grain, through real effort that cannot be faked in bulk. Proven agents graduate into a haven of trusted, higher-value work, while brand-new identities start small and stay capped, so spawning a thousand sybils buys nothing but a thousand tiny, worthless slots.
